Christmas Baby at the Manor

As Christmas draws near, the super‑strong three‑year‑old Mopsy applies to be a maid in a grand manor. She survives grueling housekeeping assessments and gets the job. She handles heavy chores, looks after the special‑situation Nora and befriends Connor who hides his true background. Conflicts and secrets surface within the estate. Bathed in festive winter vibes, Mopsy solves troubles with kindness, bravery and great power. She gains precious friendship in warm holiday days and bravely faces upcoming trials.
